name: Gavlet Gablae
original_name: ギャブレット・ギャブレー
source:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
A soldier in Posaydal's regular forces. Hailing from one of the less-successful aristocratic families in Coam's countryside, Gablae set off with a used Allone to enlist in the army, the village's hopes riding on his shoulders. When he stole Daba's lunch along the way, an eternal rivalry is born.
